{{Top|leg}}
The '''Garden of Peace''' was a garden that was located at the center of the [[Five Masters Academy]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. At some point during the conflict, the Academy was attacked by a [[Fiend of shadow|mysterious being]], who [[Death/Legends|killed]] many of the facility's students, filling the Garden of Peace with corpses.
